coding.note: Claims are restricted to the abstract, introduction and contribution list; repeated model/performance claims are consolidated. External LongBench scores concern comparators, not an independent evaluation of MiniMax. Named modifications (global router, Varlen Ring Attention, LASP+) are not coded as renames of unchanged prior techniques. claims.claim: Introduce MiniMax-Text-01 and MiniMax-VL-01 with top-tier benchmark performance.
claims.quote:
We introduce MiniMax-01 series, including MiniMax-Text-01 and MiniMax-VL-01, which are comparable
to top-tier models while offering superior capabilities in processing longer contexts.

claims.claim: First successful large-scale deployment of linear attention.
claims.quote:
We demonstrate the first successful large-scale implementation of linear attention. While
  linear attention has been studied before, it has never been deployed at this scale.
